result.summary: Adds an optional boolean option `sat_vb` to `getmempoolinfo`, `getnetworkinfo`, `estimatesmartfee`, and `estimaterawfee`, allowing callers to receive feerates formatted in sat/vB rather than BTC/kvB. Introduces `ValueFromFeeRate` in `core_io` to format feerates to three decimal places without integer truncation, avoiding rounding artifacts in sub-1 sat/vB environments.
result.problem: Bitcoin Core RPCs historically output feerates exclusively in BTC/kvB, whereas the broader Bitcoin ecosystem and user tooling almost universally use sat/vB. Downstream clients must manually parse and convert these values, risking rounding errors or integer truncations in sub-1 sat/vB conditions.
evidence: PR description notes that "Returning feerates in BTC/kvB it can be very burdensome and is not good practice, as the most widely adopted units are sat/vB" and points out sub-1 sat/vB rounding issues with `CFeeRate::GetFee()` (#32093).
Part of tracking issue #32093 on adopting sat/vB units across the RPC interface.
result.scope_notes: Note that while the PR description and release notes mention `getwalletinfo`, wallet RPCs are not touched in this diff.
result.changed_since_previous: No structural changes in approach; the PR continues to add `sat_vb` options and `ValueFromFeeRate` across the node and mempool RPCs with updated tests.
result.card: This pull request adds an optional sat_vb boolean option to getmempoolinfo, getnetworkinfo, estimatesmartfee, and estimaterawfee, enabling callers to receive feerates in sat/vB rather than legacy BTC/kvB. It addresses user and developer friction from client-side unit conversions, particularly eliminating rounding errors in sub-1 sat/vB feerate environments. Formatting is handled via a new ValueFromFeeRate helper providing 3 decimal digits of precision. Part of issue #32093, this change has no dependencies.

risk.why: Mistakes in RPC feerate output formatting or conversion logic could cause client applications to miscalculate transaction fees and either overpay or fail to get transactions mined.
